DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World launches December 3rd. Try the free demo now!

The latest entry in the DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS series comes to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC.

Join two young girls who have become Monster Wranglers and embark on a grand adventure through a mysterious otherworld alongside the monsters they befriend.

This trailer offers an in-depth look at the game's story, monster scouting and training systems, and the brand-new Joint Battle feature, showcasing everything that makes this adventure special.

Footage shown is from a game currently in development and is subject to change.

text:
Sniper Dan | Launch Trailer | Out Now
🎯 Clock in, Sniperintendents. It’s time to get to work!

Take on hundreds of hilarious jobs across six lively locations in Sniper Dan, a delightfully funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist.

Decipher clues, scan busy 3D scenes through your sniper scope, find the problem and make things right with one perfectly placed shot. No violence. Just wholesome chaos and good intentions.

And there’s plenty to do when you’re off the clock! Discover Mini-Games, Carnival Games, Time Attack, Ammo Hunt, Photo Mode, secret activities, rifle upgrades, customisation and an incredible amount more throughout Clumsy County.

🔥 Want to go Hotshot? The Hotshot DLC includes 18 gaming-inspired cosmetic items to customise Dan, his rifle and office.

🔍 Spot the problem.
🎯 Take the shot.
🛠️ Make things right.

Sniper Dan is out now on:
🎮 XBOX Series X|S
